scripts.render: node sound.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.41 render -o renders/tutorial.mp4 && npm run web
scripts.web: ffmpeg -y -i renders/tutorial.mp4 -vf scale=720:1280 -c:v libx264 -crf 24 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart ../public/tutorial.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -ss 3.3 -i renders/tutorial.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=720:1280 -q:v 4 ../public/tutorial-poster.jpg
